title: Cred begins operating
description: Cred developed crypto-backed borrowing and cryptocurrency yield products for customers.

title: Cred suspends customer inflows and outflows
description: Cred paused customer fund inflows and outflows while investigating financial irregularities and loss of funds.
notes: Contemporaneous reporting described both inflows and outflows as suspended.

title: Cred files Chapter 11 cases
description: Cred Inc. and related entities filed Chapter 11 proceedings in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware.
notes: The filing moved customer balances into a court-supervised liquidation process.

title: Court confirms Cred liquidation plan
description: The bankruptcy court confirmed Cred's modified first amended combined plan of liquidation and disclosure statement.
notes: Plan confirmation did not establish completed creditor repayment.

title: Cred liquidation plan becomes effective
description: Cred's confirmed liquidation plan became effective and the liquidation trust process proceeded under the plan.
notes: Plan effectiveness is an administrative milestone, not a universal recovery-completion date.

title: Former Cred CEO and CFO sentenced
description: Former Cred executives Daniel Schatt and Joseph Podulka were sentenced to federal prison after pleading guilty to wire-fraud conspiracy involving misleading representations to Cred customers.
notes: The criminal sentences concern individual conduct and do not by themselves determine bankruptcy recoveries.

title: SALT Lending begins operating
description: SALT developed a platform for loans secured by customer cryptocurrency collateral.
notes: Launch date is recorded at year-level.

title: SEC settles SALT token offering case
description: The SEC entered a settled order concerning SALT Blockchain's unregistered digital-asset token offering.
notes: This event concerns the SALT token offering, not a borrower insolvency or collateral-loss finding.

title: SALT pauses platform withdrawals
description: SALT told customers that the FTX collapse had affected its business and paused client withdrawals while limiting platform activity.
notes: The pause did not become a Chapter 11 or liquidation proceeding.

title: California suspends SALT lending license
description: California's DFPI suspended SALT Lending's financing license pending investigation after the customer withdrawal pause.
notes: The action was jurisdiction-specific and tied to the November 2022 platform restrictions.

title: SALT reaches California borrower settlement
description: SALT agreed to approximately $162,800 in borrower refunds, penalties, underwriting improvements, risk disclosures and procedures for closing or refinancing California loans.
notes: The settlement addressed California loans and does not represent a universal platform-wide recovery process.

title: SALT California license is reinstated
description: SALT stated that its California Financing Law license was reinstated and provided payoff, refinance, refund and collateral-return procedures for affected borrowers.
notes: Current first-party website and help materials support continued lending and collateral-management operations.
